description: Check a delegation started with background:true. Returns RUNNING, DONE or TIMED OUT, the elapsed time, the session id, and the last 8,000 characters of the agent's output. Each poll costs context, so wait between polls instead of checking in a tight loop. Call with no id to list all jobs.

id.description: Job id returned by delegate with background:true. Omit to list all jobs

name: check_delegation
